name: postmaker
description: Grounded social draft generator with explicit claim status for agents.

scripts.smoke: node bin/postmaker.js from-repo fixtures/source-repo --platform linkedin --platform x --out .tmp/posts && node bin/postmaker.js check .tmp/posts/post-pack.json --source fixtures/source-repo
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run check && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
